test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, L, M, N, S and T, are sitting in a row, facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between T and M. Only L sits to the right of N. Only one person sits between M and N. B sits at some place to the right of S but at some place to the left of A.

How many people sit between A and S?
solution:
Given:

Seven people, A, B, L, M, N, S and T, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only L sits to the right of N.

Only one person sits between M and N.

Only two people sit between T and M.

B sits at some place to the right of S but at some place to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aca85dd7c03d09b47e3f57af2c78479cdcff66cc86303f26f497c435922c993.png] 

Thus, 2 people sit between A and S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
